posts.title: A non-cancellable read action in IntelliJ’s own test runner — and how it got fixed
posts.summary: How I found a textbook cause of UI freezes in IntelliJ IDEA with my own inspection, reported it to JetBrains, and how they fixed it.

cases.title: A blocking read action in IntelliJ’s test runner
cases.problem: SearchForTestsTask mixed a cancellable read action with a blocking one and never checked for cancellation, a known cause of UI freezes.
cases.work: I found it with Background ReadAction Freeze Companion and filed it with the analysis.

cases.title: A new inspection: String.compareTo() used for equality
cases.problem: IDEA-279659 asked to flag compareTo(...) == 0 on strings and offer equals() instead.
cases.work: I wrote the inspection and its quick-fix, guarded against the null-argument difference between the two calls.

cases.title: jackson-databind inside two high-severity advisories
cases.problem: The core module of Bancolombia’s data-mask pinned jackson-databind 3.2.2, affected by two high-severity advisories.
cases.work: I reported it and suggested the patch release 3.2.3 on the same branch.
cases.result: The maintainers chose another fix: Spring Boot 4.1.2, which brings 3.1.7, outside the affected range.

cases.title: Package File held a read lock during file I/O
cases.caption: Wait of a key press, WAR with a 40 MB JAR
cases.problem: All the copying and repacking ran inside one blocking read action, so a key press waited for it.
cases.work: I measured it and moved the I/O outside the read action, keeping only the artifact lookup inside.
cases.result: JetBrains merged the change into master.

cases.title: High-severity advisories in an Elixir service
cases.problem: The channel-sender service of Bancolombia’s async-dataflow pinned cowboy, cowlib, plug_cowboy and plug inside high-severity advisories.
cases.work: I reported each advisory. The maintainers corrected several points and added one that my report had missed.
cases.result: They upgraded the dependencies in pull request #149, which closed the report.

cases.title: Settings › Plugins took most of a second to open
cases.caption: With 158 plugins loaded
cases.problem: For each plugin, the page walked the dependencies of every essential plugin, on the UI thread.
cases.work: I compute the required set once per plugin set; it gives the same answer for 158 of 158 plugins.
cases.result: Not merged yet: the pull request awaits review.

cases.title: A new inspection for System.nanoTime() comparisons
cases.problem: IDEA-266545 asked for a check on < and > comparisons of System.nanoTime() calls.
cases.work: I wrote the inspection (Probable bugs, off by default); the correct subtraction idiom is not flagged.
cases.result: Not merged yet: the pull request awaits review.

cases.title: map.remove(key, value) in Simplifiable Map operations
cases.problem: IDEA-279282 asked to detect a get, compare and remove sequence that one call replaces; a JetBrains maintainer requested it.
cases.work: I extended the existing inspection to offer map.remove(key, value), guarded against null values and side effects.
cases.result: Not merged yet: the pull request awaits review.

cases.title: Live Templates settings stopped the UI thread after every click
cases.caption: Template comparison, same result
cases.problem: After each click or key press, the page compared 1,295 templates against 336 context types on the UI thread.
cases.work: I proposed a one-line check: two templates with equal context settings cannot differ in any context type.
cases.result: Not merged yet: the pull request awaits review.

cases.title: File-type detection on the UI thread in LSP4IJ
cases.problem: Red Hat’s LSP4IJ requested document symbols on the UI thread, which can read the file content: one slow call per open file when a language server starts.
cases.work: I sent the maintainer the exact path in the current code and a fix: run the request on a pooled thread.
cases.result: The maintainer made that change the same day and closed the issue.

cases.title: Auto-test blocked the keystroke that resumes typing
cases.caption: On a 50,000-line file
cases.problem: After a typing pause, every changed file was checked for errors in one blocking read action.
cases.work: I measured it with the platform test framework and proposed a non-blocking read action.
cases.result: Not merged yet: the pull request awaits review.

cases.title: Slow typing in large files with the Structure view open
cases.caption: Median keystroke, against 33 ms without the Structure view
cases.problem: With the Structure view open on a file with 10,000 methods, every keystroke restores 10,001 smart pointers.
cases.work: I posted a headless reproduction on the ticket: 98% of the time is in doRestoreElement().
cases.result: Open: the test is attached to the ticket and matches the slow typing reported in IJPL-173280.

cases.title: A messaging library pinned to 10 advisories
cases.caption: Security advisories in OSV
cases.problem: Bancolombia’s reactive-commons-go pinned a dependency inside the range of 10 advisories, 3 of them critical.
cases.work: I reported it with every advisory checked against OSV and the version that fixes them all.
cases.result: The maintainers upgraded the dependency in pull request #6 and closed the report.

cases.title: Dependency Viewer blocked typing during its search
cases.caption: Wait of a write action, 2,000 files
cases.problem: The whole usage search ran in one blocking read action, so a key press waited until it ended.
cases.work: I wrote a headless test that reproduces it and proposed a non-blocking read action.
cases.result: Not merged yet: the pull request awaits review.

cases.title: ConcurrentModificationException in the workspace model
cases.problem: An unsynchronized map changed in the middle of an iteration and threw the exception.
cases.work: I located the iteration in the current source and posted the analysis on the ticket.
cases.result: JetBrains fixed it with a different change: the index is brought up to date before it is read.

cases.title: A crash when plugins load or unload
cases.problem: createTools() iterates a live, unsynchronized view of a map that a plugin unload can change.
cases.work: I checked the current master: the same live view is still there, so the 2020 failure looks reproducible.
cases.result: Open: the analysis is on the ticket.

cases.title: A Git lookup racing the closing of a project
cases.problem: The repository lookup runs under a deprecated read action, and nothing in its call chain checks for cancellation.
cases.work: I traced the new call chain after a widget restructuring and posted it on the ticket.
cases.result: Open: the race window is narrower than when it was reported, but it is still there.

cases.title: Git Log emptied by a stack overflow
cases.problem: processLeafPages recurses with no depth guard, so a large enough index overflows the stack.
cases.work: I showed that IJPL-250279, reported a year later, is the same failure, and proposed an iterative traversal.
cases.result: Open: the analysis is on the ticket.

cases.title: A memory leak in ProjectRootManagerImpl
cases.problem: A batch counter can stay above 0 after one exception, and a list of changes then grows on every roots event.
cases.work: I pointed to the missing safety net in the code. I did not trace the exact first imbalance.
cases.result: Open: the analysis is on the ticket.
